title: Good: encrypt.rs RSA preflight getrandom call before PKCS#1v15 encrypt
description: smime-tree/src/encrypt.rs: before calling RSA PKCS#1v15 encrypt for key transport, the code performs a preflight check by calling getrandom for 256 random bytes and returning UnwrapErr(SysRng) if the system RNG is unavailable. This ensures the encrypt operation fails fast with a diagnostic error rather than panicking or silently producing a deterministic (zero-random) ciphertext if the RNG is broken. The preflight is especially important for PKCS#1v15, which is susceptible to Bleichenbacher attacks if randomness is weak. The invariant is documented in a comment. Worth defending against removal as a 'redundant' check.
